subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt the open conflicting fork PR, close it and sponsor a same-repository fix, or keep this issue waiting on the fork author?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the only open closing PR is outside the target repository and currently conflicting, so automation should not queue a competing repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor a same-repository fix
options.body: Create or allow a focused current-main patch in the direct Anthropic transport/header path with regression tests for OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer to retarget the fork work into the main repository, update it for current direct transport behavior, and require proof before merge.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Leave this issue open without a new repair lane until the fork PR becomes a viable landing path or is closed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Create or allow a focused current-main patch in the direct Anthropic transport/header path with regression tests for OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the direct Anthropic transport and shared header helper paths where recent history most strongly points to Vincent Koc.
